# dsh-notify-linux
**English** | 中文文档

Desktop notifications and a chime for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) on
Linux + GNOME. DSH tells you when it

has finished a turn, when it is waiting for you to
choose something, when a tool call needs your ap
proval, and when something failed.

The notifications are sent **by the DSH host process**, not by the browser page — so they
still arri

ve when the page is in a background tab, when the window is minimized, or when
the page is closed en

the page is in a background tab, when the window is minimized, or when
the page is closed entirely.

- No npm runtime dependencies (the host half uses only Node built-ins)
- Notifications via `notify-s

end`, sounds via `paplay` with a `canberra-gtk-play` fallback
- Browser-side fallback (in-page toast

, Web Notification, synthesized Web Audio chime)
for environments where the system paths are unavail

able
- All switches configurable in the DSH Settings page or by editing a single JSON file
## What it notifies you about

Four event kinds. Each one has its own toggle, its own urgency and icon, and its own
sound (except `
turnEnd`, which uses the theme you select).
| Kind | Trigger | Notification title | Urgency | Icon | Sound |
| `turnEnd` | The whole agent turn is stopping — the model no longer owes a response | `DSH 已完成任务` |

normal | `dialog-information` | selected theme |
| `question` | The model requests an answer from y
ou (single choice / multi choice / free text) | `DSH 正在等待你的选择` | normal | `dialog-information` | `me

ssage-new-instant` |
| `approval` | A tool call is waiting for a human to allow it | `DSH 需要你的批准` |

normal | `dialog-information` | `dialog-information` |
| `error` | A step or a whole turn failed | `
DSH 执行出错` | critical | `dialog-error` | `dialog-error` |

The notification body identifies the session, so you can tell which piece of work it
refers to. Form
at: `<workspace> · <8-char session id>` plus the event detail, e.g.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`turnEnd` fires on `agent/turn-stopping` — the point where the turn is genuinely over.
Tool-call rou
nd trips do not trigger it; only the end of the whole turn does.

> The notification strings are currently Chinese (they are emitted from the host half).
> The Settin
gs page itself is fully localized (Chinese and English).
## Why the host half sends the notifications

A browser-only notification scheme has a hard limitation: it only works while the page is
open and t

he browser is alive. Switch to another window, minimize the browser, or close
the tab, and the notif
ication is simply never delivered.

The DSH host process lives longer than the page. `notify-send` goes through the GNOME
notification c

enter, so the notification — and the sound — still reach you when the page
is unfocused, when the br
owser is in the background, or when the page is not open at all.
The browser half therefore does three different things instead of duplicating delivery:
| Half | File | Responsibility |
| Host | `index.js` (500 lines) | Listens to the four events, sends the real system notification and

sound, persists config, serves the HTTP API |
| Browser | `client.js` (682 lines) | Settings page,
in-page toast overlay, and fallback via Web Notification / Web Audio when the host could not deliver
-page toast overlay, and fallback via Web Notification / Web Audio when the host could not deliver |

Whether the browser falls back is decided by two booleans the host returns with each
event — `deskto

p` and `sound`, meaning "this was actually dispatched". If the system
notification did go out, the b
rowser stays quiet, so you are never notified twice.
## Requirements
| Item | Detail |

| Platform | **Linux + GNOME** (verified on Manjaro GNOME, Wayland) |
| DSH | Any DSH build with the

Cordis plugin system (`webServer`, `settings.section` slots) |
| Node | **>= 22** (DSH's own requir

ement) |
| Notifications | `notify-send` from **libnotify** |
| Sounds | `paplay` from **pulseaudio-

utils**, or `canberra-gtk-play` from **libcanberra** |
| Sound files | `/usr/share/sounds/freedeskto

p/stereo` (the freedesktop sound theme) |
| npm dependencies | **none** — `package.json` has no `dep

he freedesktop sound theme) |
| npm dependencies | **none** — `package.json` has no `dependencies` |

Everything external is optional in the sense that the plugin degrades gracefully: if
`notify-send` i

s missing, the plugin reports that capability as unavailable and the
browser half can take over with

Web Notifications. Nothing is ever awaited on the event
path — a missing or failing command can nev

Nothing is ever awaited on the event
path — a missing or failing command can never stall the agent.

The plugin probes for its tools at runtime and reports the result in the Settings page
(`notify-send
`, `paplay`, `canberra-gtk-play` — each shown as available or not).
## Installation

This is a DSH Cordis plugin **bundle**. Install it through DSH's plugin manager
(`plugin_manager`, a
ction `install_bundle`), pointing it at either:

- the **local directory** — `/home/wlaeg/文档/deepseek-harness/default-workspace/dsh-notify`
- or the
**Git repository** — `https://github.com/Wlaeg/dsh-notify-linux`
The bundle declares its own patch in `package.json`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
and the patch is a single `insert` that mounts the host half:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The browser half is declared by `dsh.client` and bound to the row whose `name` is the
bare package n
ame — subpath rows do not carry a browser half.
[该节后续省略]
## Architecture
### Security boundary

DSH's `webServer` often binds `0.0.0.0`, but these routes can change plugin configuration
and trigge

r real notifications — they must not be open to the public internet. Every
request passes through `a
llowed(req)`, which permits only:

16`
- `172.16.0.0/12`
- IPv6 unique-local `fc00::/7` and link-local `fe80::/10`
Anything else gets `403 {"error":"forbidden"}`. Request bodies are capped at 64 KiB.
